name: Usingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Usingen (a yellow lion on blue and a green clover leaf on white).
history: Municipal flag of Usingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Usingen arms — lion and clover leaf
